scope: Native typed slot allocator/error handler with full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/SR/PR/MACL equality. Types1/2/3, invalid0/4/-1, empty/full/last-free/fragmented pools, flag2 availability, FPU banks; independent first-available pointer, occupation flag, preserved other pools/fields, output and error values. Sequential allocations consume every remaining free slot followed by repeated exhaustion, checking full state after each call. Release and reacquisition of a slot in every typed pool verified after exhaustion. Fixture sound context; null context/output outside contract not tested.
